whatIsIt.eli5: Adds several pictures of the same size, but learns how much each should count.
whatIsIt.simple: Learnable weighted sum of 2–4 same-size maps (fast normalised fusion from BiFPN). Can replace a Concat when the inputs have equal channels.
whatIsIt.engineer: Σ ReLU(w_i)·x_i / (Σ ReLU(w_j) + ε), one weight per input.

whyExists.eli5: Some inputs are more useful than others.
whyExists.simple: Concat treats all inputs the same and doubles the channels; weighted fusion learns their importance and keeps channels fixed, which is cheaper for the next block.
whyExists.engineer: Learned input importance in multi-scale fusion (Tan et al., 2020).

simple: All inputs must have the same shape.
Weights are kept positive and normalised.
engineer: n params; inputs often need 1×1 Convs first to match channels.
